design_philosophy: The Performance Pro meets Swiss High-Contrast. Strict, data-dense, authoritative, and frictionless. Eliminates decorative visual noise to prioritize quantitative legibility and market signal clarity.

headings.usage: Headers, panel titles, summary card metrics.

data_table.usage: All numerical data, tickers, stock prices, volumes. CRITICAL: Must use tabular-nums utility to prevent horizontal layout shift during the 2s data refresh.

rules: No drop shadows or heavy blur effects on data surfaces.
Use explicit 1px solid borders (`border-zinc-800`) to separate sections and table cells.
Dashboard components should sit flush or use 4px (rounded-sm) border radius maximum for a sharp, technical feel.

header.components: Title on left, System Status Badges (DEMO, RUNNING) on right. Use neon-accented dots for 'RUNNING' status.

main_grid.classes: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-px bg-zinc-800 border border-zinc-800
main_grid.description: Use a 1px gap with a border background to create crisp technical grid lines between the left main content and right sidebar.

summary_cards.style: Flat, 1px border, dense padding (p-4). Metric value large (text-3xl), label small (text-xs uppercase).

data_table.alignment: Left-align string columns (Symbol). Right-align ALL numerical columns (LTP, Qty, Prices).
data_table.density: High. Use py-2 px-3 for table cells. No excessive whitespace.
data_table.placeholders: Render placeholder cells (SMMA, AI Probability) with a muted text color (text-zinc-500) and '—' or 'Pending' to clearly separate Phase 1 vs Phase 2 features.

detail_panel.content: Sticky positioning. Top half: Market Depth (Bids vs Asks). Bottom half: Blurred or wireframed empty states marked 'Not implemented in Phase 1'.

table.customization: Override default borders. Add vertical borders between specific column groups (e.g., separating Price data from Volume data). Row hover state should be `hover:bg-zinc-900`.

badges.customization: Square or rounded-sm. Use outline variants for secondary status, solid vibrant colors for LIVE/RUNNING states.

motion.tick_flash: When market data (LTP, Bid/Ask) updates every 2 seconds, implement a subtle background flash on the changed cell. `bg-emerald-500/20` for upward movement, `bg-red-500/20` for downward. Fade out over 500ms.
motion.hover: Instant hover states (100ms) for data rows, no slow transitions that feel sluggish.

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL FONTS: Ensure you include Google Fonts for Chivo, IBM Plex Sans, and JetBrains Mono.
TABULAR NUMS: Absolutely critical. All numbers in the table must have the `tabular-nums` Tailwind class so the table doesn't jiggle horizontally when prices update.
SIMULATOR: Implement a `setInterval` or custom React hook to randomize the mock market data every 2 seconds to simulate the websocket.
TEST IDS: Add `data-testid` to rows, filter statuses, and badges (e.g., `data-testid='stock-row-RELIANCE'`, `data-testid='system-status-badge'`).
PLACEHOLDERS: Do not omit columns that are for future phases. Include them but display '—' or 'Pending' as requested by the user, colored in `text-zinc-600`.
COLOR STRICTNESS: Only use Emerald/Red for financial positive/negative. Do not use them for decorative UI elements.
MODULARITY: Keep the data fetching/simulation logic in a separate hook (`useMarketData`) so it can easily be swapped for Angel One SmartAPI WebSockets later.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never center align the app container. No generic centered layouts.
Dark mode is the default and only mode for this specific trading UI.
Use 1px explicit borders for hierarchy. Avoid shadows on dark mode.
Implement micro-animations on interactive elements but avoid `transition-all`. Target specific properties.
Use `lucide-react` for any necessary UI icons, but keep them minimal.
Ensure all text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards on dark backgrounds.
